usedFor: Mural holds stickies and rooms, HubSpot receives people as contacts, and “New Sticky” can start “Create or Update Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Sticky” in Mural, then “Create or Update Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: It creates the contact, or updates an existing one by its email.

watchOut: Mural triggers such as “New Sticky” are polling, so the HubSpot contact appears after a short delay.
